About Us

Nigeria-Born, Globally Trusted Innovation Group

Zorent Limited is a dynamic conglomerate — we are based in Port Harcourt, with presence in major cities across Nigeria and the rest of the world, encompassing three specialised divisions: Zorent Limited (Education Consult), Zorent Limited (Escrow Division), and Zorent Limited (Properties Division).

Together, we are committed to delivering excellence and innovation across education, real estate, and financial security — enhancing lives and empowering communities.

Vision: To be a globally trusted and innovative company — rooted in Nigeria, serving Africa and the rest of the world — enhancing lives and empowering communities through unmatched quality, integrity, and sustainable growth.

Mission: Delivering exceptional services that exceed client expectations, drive national progress, and create lasting value through compliance, feedback, and responsible corporate practices.

Why Choose Zorent Limited (Education Consult)?

🎓 End-to-end support — from application to enrolment and beyond
🌍 Verified pathways across Nigeria, Africa, Russia, and the UK
📈 Proven track record — 24 scholarship placements in 2023 alone
🤝 Dedicated advisors for schools, professionals, and families

Our Expert Services:

1. Healthcare Caregiver Education

Equips individuals with internationally accredited skills to meet the rising demand for professional caregivers. Our programs provide practical expertise for roles in hospitals, home care and abroad, professionalizing the caregiving sector across Nigeria, Africa, and the rest of the world.

2. School Startup Consultancy

Expert guidance for establishing new educational institutions across Nigeria, Africa, and the rest of the world. We manage the entire process from concept and regulatory compliance to curriculum design and operational setup, ensuring sustainable growth for new primary and secondary schools.

3. School Improvement Strategies

Tailored interventions to revitalize existing schools. We diagnose challenges and implement strategic plans to enhance teaching quality, operational efficiency, and student outcomes, helping institutions achieve academic excellence.

4. Teacher Recruitment Solutions

Connects schools with top-tier teaching talent. We go beyond filling vacancies by sourcing, vetting, and placing qualified educators who align with your institution's values and standards, ensuring a high-calibre teaching workforce.

5. Online Tutoring (Grade 5–12)

Flexible, high-quality tutoring accessible to all. Leveraging technology, we offer specialised instruction in core academic subjects, making expert education available to students across Nigeria, Africa, and the rest of the world.

6. Training Curriculum Development

Creates innovative, skill-focused educational programs aligned with international standards. We develop curricula for healthcare, corporate, and academic settings, ensuring learners acquire relevant competencies for the evolving demands of the Nigerian and global economy.

7. Foreign University Admissions

Expert assistance for students seeking admission to prestigious international institutions. From application to acceptance, we guide candidates through the complex process, increasing chances of securing a place at top universities worldwide.

8. Foreign Scholarship Acquisition

Dedicated support to secure life-changing educational funding. We provide strategic assistance in identifying opportunities, crafting compelling applications, and navigating selection processes, making international study accessible for scholars across Nigeria, Africa, and the rest of the world.

9. Continuous Professional Development for Teachers

Ongoing, high-impact training programs to keep educators at the forefront of best practices. We deliver workshops and certifications that enhance teaching skills and career advancement, building a stronger, more effective teaching workforce across Nigeria, Africa, and the rest of the world.

10. Russian Government Scholarship (Bachelors, Masters & PhD)

A 99% sure path to fully funded education in Russia. Our comprehensive service assists applicants through the two-stage exam process, from motivational letters to university selection, leveraging our proven high success rate to help students from Nigeria, Africa, and the rest of the world secure this prestigious opportunity.

Escrow Services

Zorent Limited(Escrow Division)

Secure, traceable, and reliable escrow services for online transactions, real estate deals, and purchases — especially for diaspora clients. We are based in Port Harcourt, with presence in major cities across Nigeria and the rest of the world. Your transactions are in safe, fully accountable hands.

Why Choose Zorent Escrow?

  • 🌍 Worldwide coverage, local Nigerian expertise
  • 🔍 Fully traceable & vetted personalities
  • 🛡️ Transparent & accountable process
  • 🤝 Neutral dispute resolution

Our Escrow Services:

1. Real Estate Guarantee

Secures property transactions by acting as a trusted intermediary. We hold funds safely until all legal and contractual conditions are met, protecting buyers and sellers from fraud — ensuring financial safety and title authenticity in high-value real estate deals across Nigeria, Africa, and the rest of the world.

2. E-commerce Guarantee

Provides a secure and transparent framework for online transactions. By safeguarding payments until buyers confirm satisfactory delivery, we mitigate fraud risks and build trust in the growing digital economy across Nigeria, Africa, and the rest of the world, enabling worry-free online shopping and business.

3. Diaspora Purchase Guarantee

A specialised service for Nigerians abroad. We manage local property and goods purchases on their behalf, holding payments securely and coordinating delivery, ensuring their investments are safe, transparent, and executed seamlessly without being physically present.

Visual Overview

Escrow Agreement
Real Estate Transactions
E-commerce Protection

How Escrow Works:

1

Agreement

Buyer & seller agree on terms.

2

Deposit

Buyer sends funds to Zorent Escrow — not the seller.

3

Verification

Funds held while seller delivers.

4

Delivery

Buyer confirms receipt and satisfaction.

5

Release

Zorent releases payment to seller. ✅

Why Choose Zorent Properties?

  • 🗺️ Local market expertise across Nigeria's key property corridors

2

Our Property Services:

1. Sales of Properties

Facilitates the secure and transparent sale of various properties, from residential homes to commercial assets. Our service ensures a seamless transaction process, connecting buyers and sellers with professional support and trusted escrow options to guarantee a fair and protected deal.

2. Leases of Properties

Manages the leasing process for agricultural, industrial, and residential properties. We match tenants with ideal spaces, handle negotiations, and ensure lease agreements are clear and beneficial, providing a hassle-free experience for landlords and tenants alike.

3. Trustee & Escrow in Real Estate

Acts as a neutral third party to safeguard funds until all conditions of a property deal are met. This service is essential for managing risk, ensuring that both the buyer's payment and the seller's title are protected, fostering confidence in complex real estate transactions.
